† And Iacob cometh into Socoth: where hauing built a
houſe, and pitched his tents, he called the name of that
place Socoth, that is, Tabernacles. † And he paſſed into 18
Salem a citie of the Sichimites, which is in the land of Cha-
naan, after he returned from Meſopotamia of Siria: and
he dwelt beſide the towne. † And he bought that part of
the field, wherin he had pitched his tents, of the children
of Hemor, the father fo Sichem for an hundred lambes.

Np Dina the daughter of Lia went forth :: to ſee the
Æwemen of that countrie. † Whom when Sichem had
ſeene the ſonne of Hemor the Heuite, the prince of that
land, he was in loue with her: and he tooke her away, and
lay with her, by force raui ſhing the virgin. † And his ſoule 3:
was faſt kint vnto her, and wheras ine was ſad, he com-
forted her with ſweete wordes. † And going to Hemor:
his father, he ſaid : Take me this wench to be my wife.
